latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator — Auto-Generate Captions for Videos.

- Instantly generate accurate English and Spanish captions for uploaded video files up to 500MB.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more for seamless upload and export in 1080p MP4.
- No editing experience needed: simply describe your needs to auto-generate captions in 30-60 seconds.
- Anonymous free accounts supported with 100 credits for 7 days; easy backend connection and error handling.
- Ideal for quick, professional-quality captioning for content creators, marketers, and video producers.
